lede: UCF carries the stronger underlying team rating — +5.2 against +1.8, a 3.4-point separation on a neutral field before home advantage, travel or rest.
EdgeDesk makes it Houston -9.8 before any sportsbook number is consulted, with Houston winning 74% of simulations.
The position-group comparison shows where the separation comes from: the widest measured gap is defense, where UCF leads Houston by 86 places nationally.
Data confidence on this matchup is 78% — high by this board’s standards, so the margin is the strongest part of the read.
